title: nerine laticoma subsp. sandersonii
intro: Nerine laticoma subsp. sandersonii, commonly known as the Sanderson's nerine or Nerine sandersonia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Amaryllidaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in traditional medicine. The plant's therapeutic actions include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of various infections. Bioactive constituents of Nerine laticoma subsp. sandersonii include alkaloids, particularly galanthamine, which is known for its potential to treat conditions such as Alzheimer's disease and other neurological disorders.
